# s265 — relay-roles recommend's yes/no error must not offer any

`ops.parse_yes_no` delegates to `_parse_yes_no_any`. That function rejects any value that is not yes, no or any with the message "must be yes, no or any", so `relay-roles recommend --split maybe` tells the user to try `any`, which `recommend` also refuses. `parse_yes_no` should check for yes or no itself, so every refused value gets "must be yes or no".

**Findings:** s259 gate, 2026-10-13: recommend --split maybe fails with 'must be yes, no or any', but recommend accepts only yes or no · **Size:** S · **Tree:** slicer

**Not in this slice:** changing the `bad_role_field` code, changing `_parse_yes_no_any` or the `add`/`set` flags that accept `any`, and changing which values `recommend` accepts.

## Why

The s259 gate found this (low). The error code is correct, but the message points at a value the command then refuses. It was left out of s259 because any code change after the gate would have needed another gate.

## Files

src/slicer/ops.py (`parse_yes_no`), tests/test_relay_roles.py, CHANGELOG.md.

## Failing tests

- `relay-roles recommend ID --well-specified maybe --split no` exits 2 with `bad_role_field`. Its message says "yes or no" and does not contain "any".
- The same holds for `--split maybe`.
- `--split any` still exits 2 with `bad_role_field` and "yes or no".

## Implement

1. In `parse_yes_no`, refuse any value other than yes or no with the "must be yes or no" message before mapping it, without going through `_parse_yes_no_any`.
2. Add the tests and a CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` entry.
